Embedding request with multiple inputs returns multiple embedding objects

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val req = mapper.readValue("{\"input\":[\"Hello world\",\"Goodbye world\"],\"model\":\"text-embedding-3-small\"}", EmbeddingRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.embed(req)
    println(result.data)
    println(result.data.first().index)
    println(result.data.get(1).index)
}
```
